quotes.text: sounds like a rhiza problem. we should be co-locating like processes in the same window with tiled panes.
quotes.where: this conversation, after the plan runs failed on the window limit

fields.summary: A plan run's review, critic and fixer sessions each open their own Rex window, so one session hit Rex's 64-window limit and failed four runs. The owner wants processes that belong to one run co-located in one window as tiled panes.
fields.title: Rhiza runs open too many Rex windows
